'''Tynes''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] stationed on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] around [[3643 BBY]], when he was [[Death/Legends|killed]].

==Behind the scenes==
Tynes appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Champion boss on Korriban. He is not directly involved in any quests, but can be killed for loot and as part of the achievement. This article assumes 100% game completion, which means he was killed.
